purpose: Supplement native scores with local-evidence case review; no semantic scoring model and no altered benchmark metric.
goal_review: Review all changed final texts after all90 triples complete, including unchanged native scores. Record material support separately from answer-string agreement.
ordinary_review: Before ordinary inference begins, select6 nodes per dataset by ascending SHA256 of r03-stage90-ordinary-review-v1| plus node id. Review complete statements and answer relevance using the actual current question and frozen reader/history. Report this18-node diagnostic sample only; it is not176-node factual accuracy or a downstream score.
limits: Posthoc goal explanations are observations, not independently randomized causes. Do not infer factual correctness from score alone, or wrongness from absence of a string in a passage. No prompt edits or rerolls after inspecting results. No claim that a sample demonstrates full-RAG improvement.
